description: This file declares an API for subscribing to notifications when the current working directory changes. It includes function prototypes for registering, unregistering, reparenting, and performing directory change notifications, as well as a callback type definition. The file comments describe the intended usage for clients interested in directory change events.

methods.name: chdir_notify_register
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked when the current working directory changes. Takes a name, callback pointer, and user data.

methods.name: chdir_notify_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered callback identified by name, callback, and data.

methods.name: chdir_notify_reparent
methods.description: Adjusts a relative path from an old root to a new root based on directory change.

methods.name: chdir_notify
methods.description: Changes the directory to a new path and notifies all registered callbacks.

methods.name: reparent_relative_path
methods.description: Reparents a relative path from one directory root to another, adjusting or returning absolute paths as needed.

ctags.name: chdir_notify_callback
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(const char * name,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd,void * data)
